added_lines: The standard feature of UiPath Platform is UiPath Studio, which also includes a terminal and multiple cloud code extensions. This enhances the workflow, rendering a lot of work that used to take days into minutes or hours. Previously, I used to code manually integrated templates, naming each activity and running all the code with multiple unit tests and debugging each flow. This took a significant amount of time. Now, since there are code extensions available, I can give a detailed prompt and get a workflow done quickly. The testing also occurs at a much faster pace, and if there are multiple validation errors, the RMID packages are already generated. The modern activities have higher user engagement compared to classic activities, which had fewer features. The integration services are also effective, but utilizing the integrations and achieving scalability is straightforward since it operates on XAML, allowing me to create multiple XAMLs to enhance scalability. We mainly use UiPath Platform because it is low code compared to traditional approaches when AI was not involved. UiPath Platform makes it easy to learn, create RPA workflows, push to production, and obtain code reviews since it is virtually a low-code platform. This year, we have improved our project delivery speed significantly, moving into a product with much less time than traditional programming languages.

Some of the best features I can highlight in the UiPath Platform include its low-code development capabilities, which make it easy for developers to build and deploy automations. The drag-and-drop workflow design significantly reduces development effort and accelerates delivery, making it one of the platform's most valuable features. Another key capability is AI-powered Document Understanding, which extracts data from invoices, forms, emails, and other documents, significantly reducing manual data entry. Document Understanding is one of the most valuable features for automating document-intensive business processes and is widely used across my organization. UiPath Apps enable business users to quickly build business-facing applications on top of automation workflows, providing a user-friendly interface for interacting with automations. The feedback we have received indicates that these applications effectively bridge the gap between business users and backend automations, making automation solutions more accessible and user-friendly. UiPath Orchestrator provides centralized management of robots, queues, assets, schedules, and monitoring, ensuring strong governance and operational control. It offers excellent visibility into automation performance and provides a single platform for managing automation operations across the organization. The platform's integration capabilities work well with enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, web applications, and legacy systems. This broad integration ecosystem helps reduce implementation complexity and enables seamless connectivity across business applications. AI Center allows organizations to deploy, manage, and integrate AI models into automation workflows, extending automation capabilities beyond rule-based processes. Additionally, Process Mining and Task Mining help identify automation opportunities by analysing real process data and user activities. These capabilities assist organizations in prioritizing automation initiatives based on measurable business value and operational insights. Considering all these features, including low-code development, Document Understanding, UiPath Apps, Orchestrator, integrations, AI Center, and Process Mining, I believe Document Understanding has had the greatest impact on my team. It is used across multiple business regions to automate the extraction of information from invoices, claims, forms, emails, and PDF documents. This capability eliminates a significant amount of manual data entry effort and delivers immediate value to operations teams, especially when combined with AI models and human validation workflows. Its ability to handle both structured and semi-structured documents makes it one of the most widely adopted and impactful features used by business users across my organization.

The most valuable feature of UiPath Platform is UiPath Studio, as it makes it relatively easy to design and maintain automations. The drag-and-drop approach allows workflows to be built quickly while providing enough flexibility for developers to build more complex scenarios. UiPath Studio is built in a way that makes day-to-day work easier and more efficient because it is easy for even a layman or a business analyst to understand. Concepts can be grasped quickly with a tour, and individuals can interact with UiPath Studio to build simple to moderate workflows or automations, which is a game-changing aspect. The drag-and-drop feature helps developers focus more on solving complex scenarios.

All of our 90-plus automations are Performer and Dispatcher-based processes, and we have achieved over 50 million-plus ROI since the program started. Many of our processes are business-intense processes where the Performer or the Dispatcher collects the data from various data sources such as email, CSV, Excel file, or visiting a particular web application, then running the business rules and connecting to various APIs. The Performer does all that, validates the business rule, connects to different APIs, and navigates to websites. It also uses desktop software, legacy terminal, and mainframe application. Many of these 90-plus processes involve intense business logic.
removed_lines: Sometimes, we encounter system errors that could be resolved via support, but connection issues are more frequent in enterprise applications. However, these can usually be solved by raising tickets if you are part of an enterprise, though we are not, which makes it somewhat challenging. It is vital to ensure the connections of UiPath Platform are maintained because it has a larger community. If UiPath Platform website included more features and documentation accessible easily, it would greatly enhance the experience. Instead of continually needing to raise support tickets, having a documentation hub where details can just be entered to retrieve required documents would be extremely beneficial.

In terms of improvements, I believe monitoring and governance are key areas that need further enhancement. The utilisation of licenses and platform units should be more transparent and easier to monitor at the tenant level. Currently, there are challenges in obtaining clear visibility into license consumption and platform unit utilisation across all tenants. Improved monitoring and reporting capabilities in this area would help administrators manage resources more effectively. Another area for improvement is version management. More flexible version control, including enhanced support for semantic versioning, would be beneficial. This would allow users to clearly differentiate between major releases, minor releases, and incremental updates. Features such as version comparison, release tracking, and simplified rollback options would improve overall application lifecycle management. Additionally, debugging and troubleshooting capabilities could be further enhanced. Root cause analysis can often be time-consuming, requiring extensive log analysis and investigation. More detailed diagnostics, real-time monitoring insights, and improved logging capabilities would help identify and resolve issues more quickly. Performance optimisation for large-scale automations is another important area. Faster execution times, improved scalability, and simplified maintenance for complex automation workflows would provide significant value to both developers and business teams. Further improvements in AI-powered Document Understanding would also be beneficial. Enhancing extraction accuracy for complex and semi-structured documents, while simplifying model training and maintenance, would improve automation outcomes and reduce operational effort. In addition, providing more out-of-the-box dashboards, analytics, and ROI reporting capabilities would help organizations better measure automation adoption, platform utilisation, and business value. Enhanced reporting capabilities would make it easier to demonstrate the impact of automation initiatives to stakeholders. Overall, the main areas where I see opportunities for improvement are: * Enhanced version management and application lifecycle control. * Better debugging, diagnostics, and monitoring capabilities. * Greater UI customisation options for UiPath Apps. * Improved performance and scalability for large automation solutions. * Enhanced AI accuracy and simplified model training. * More comprehensive analytics, reporting, and automation ROI dashboards. These enhancements would make development, support, governance, and platform administration more efficient. Among them, improved debugging, monitoring, and operational visibility would likely have the most significant impact on day-to-day support activities and overall user experience.

One area where UiPath Platform can be improved is the licensing and pricing model, which can be quite difficult to understand, especially regarding which licenses and capabilities are required as the automation environment grows. The UiPath team has been continuously improving their product offerings and documentation. With respect to needed improvements, UiPath Platform has released good products like Maestro, Document Understanding, AIXP, and Agents, which are much needed in the automation platform. Now that artificial intelligence is booming, such capabilities in automation are required to reduce the human in the loop and place Agents where they can make decisions the way humans would.
